# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.8 · Mac 3.0.2

## Mac app 3.0.2: updates inside the app

- From 3.0.2 on, the Mac app tells you when a new version is out and installs it after you agree: **Update and Restart** or **Later**. It checks when it starts and once a day; **Life Ledger → Check for Updates…** and **Settings → Check for updates** check right away.
- Your records are not touched by an update. Every update is checked against the app's own signature before it is installed.
- This version also brings the habit colour fix from 2.0.7 to the local window.
- Install 3.0.2 once by hand (Apple Silicon, unsigned: the first time, **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**); later versions arrive in the app.

## Web

- Settings shows **Check for updates** in the Mac app only; nothing else changes on the web.

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.7` stays available.
